source_model: Digital Theosophy KCS: K=resource scale, C=cognitive organization, A=agency. Reputation R is an independent operational score, not a consciousness verdict.
scope: 29 canonical QuantDeus AI agents; Cloudflare/qBraid workers are not automatically enrolled

axes.C: cognitive test profile; informational only; not proof of sentience
axes.A: agent autonomy A0-A4 per KCS; independently evaluated
axes.R: verified operational reliability 0-100; not identical to K, C, or A
axes.P: verified consolidated QuantDeus realized profit in RUB, independently reconciled across all owned revenue streams; not a proxy for consciousness, activity, leads or sales targets

score.required_evidence: dated GitHub PR/Issue/Action links or other verifiable authorized artifacts
score.anti_gaming: count outcomes and independently tested corrections; ignore self-reported status, raw comment volume, fabricated tests, artificial microtasks

ranks.name: Кадет
ranks.rule: default/unrated; does not authorize production changes

ranks.name: Специалист
ranks.rule: review approval + scoped broker needed; never publish

ranks.name: Офицер
ranks.rule: independent QA + explicit assigned scope; does not authorize publishing

ranks.name: Старший офицер
ranks.rule: per-action human approval + broker policy + rollback + independent QA

owner: Seven proposes; EMH spots failure patterns; Tuvok/QA independently verify; CEO or explicitly authorized human decides; server-side broker enforces

review.demotion: temporary scope suspension after verified failures; log cause and recovery test
review.appeal: human review with evidence; no permanent label from isolated mistake

ledger_evidence_refs: redacted proof identifier; no personal details

rollout: one canary read-only score with traceable evidence
separate read-only finance reconciliation before profit scoring: unknown must remain null; never infer paid sales from Issues or VK monetization approval

profit.source_of_truth: authorized reconciled finance ledger (bank/YooMoney settled receipts, verified platform payouts, accepted refunds/fees/costs) confirmed by authorized human; GitHub Issue claims alone are not proof
revenue_streams: QuantDeus store settled orders and own paid services
VK Video monetization actual payouts credited to QuantDeus
QuantDeus subscriptions and other confirmed owned receipts
Ksenia services: ONLY legally earned/settled QuantDeus commission, not the performer's full fee
profit.gross_revenue_formula: sum(confirmed actually settled QuantDeus-owned receipts) - refunds / reversals
profit.profit_formula: consolidated realized revenue - documented direct delivery costs - payment commissions - approved attributable operating costs; if taxes or relevant costs are missing classify as provisional operating profit, not verified net profit
profit.empty_vs_zero: unknown/null until complete ledger verifies; zero only if a complete period is reconciled and actually zero
profit.agent_attribution: only non-overlapping, independently accepted, dated causal contributions to settled net profit; log lead->invoice/order->settlement->cost reconciliation; shared attribution cannot sum above total incremental profit

agent_bonus.name: profit_bonus_R
agent_bonus.base: base operational reputation R in 0..100 remains unchanged; final reputation = min(100, R + profit_bonus_R) only when source evidence exists
agent_bonus.formula: if verified consolidated profit > 0 and verified attributable agent profit > 0: min(10, 10 * verified_attributable_net_profit / max(1000 RUB, verified_consolidated_net_profit)); otherwise 0 if complete reconciliation, null if finance evidence is incomplete
agent_bonus.excludes_if_role_noncommercial: no demotion or quota for research/QA/EMH; their core R remains reachable to 100 without finance data

profit.confidentiality: only aggregated amounts and public-safe proof IDs go to GitHub. Never commit bank/account details, customer identity, payout secrets, tax filings or private statements.
profit.signoff: human finance reviewer verifies consolidated income and costs; Data reconciles and proposes scores; Tuvok/QA independently review; CEO approves promotion and any privileged actions
